boundary: Automated browser, service-worker and assistive-technology regressions do not substitute for testing on physical iOS/iPadOS and Android devices. New .5 runtime candidate is not yet built, bound, or attested. Fresh real-device tests (install, update, offline, restart, storage pressure and safe-area) are required. The old .4 exact-head artifact is previous-release evidence only; screen-reader acceptance remains separately governed by data/accessibility-real-at-validation-v1.json.
privacyBoundary: Public contract metadata must not include learner names, customer/site identifiers, email addresses, private screenshots, raw process data, backup content, filesystem/user paths or other personal/proprietary evidence. Keep detailed device evidence outside the public repository and reference it only with a non-sensitive review identifier.
